provenance_convention: Each files[].dataset references datasets[].id or audit_provenance.id, which supplies source_url, request_parameters, timestamp, HTTP status, feature_count or image dimensions. Every network attempt including failed HTTP statuses is in request_ledger. Audit files are generated locally, source_url=null and http_status=null.
